end.summary: Discussed “unity in diversity” using melody, festivals, food, languages, and clothing.
end.parentNote: Riya practised explaining how different traditions can share common ideas, such as joy, celebration, and people coming together. The melody analogy and examples from Holi, Pongal, Diwali, Bihu, and Lohri helped her identify shared elements. She sometimes described different festivals as completely the same rather than similar in some ways; this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask her to make a two-column list of one shared feature and one unique feature for two festivals.
